```{r load-packages}
library(gsm.kri)
library(gsm.core)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Source utility functions
source("util/Sim_Studies.R")
source("util/Sim_ActionScores.R")
```

```{r simulate-data}
#### Step 1: Simulate Multi-Study Results and Group Data ####

# Simulate multi-study data using Sim_Studies function
sim_data <- Sim_Studies(
  dfMetrics = gsm.core::reportingMetrics,
  n_studies = 10,
  n_sites = 50,
  n_sites_per_study = c(8, 15),
  snapshot_date = as.Date("2025-06-01"),
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r simulate-actions}
#### Step 2: Simulate ActionLogs and Adjusted Risk Scores ####

# One synthetic action per flagged site KRI in each study, within the last
# 90 days: mostly Open or Closed, about 10% No Action. Scored per study with
# the same Analyze_ActionRiskScore() call as the Site KRI Report. Action dates
# are labelled snapshot-date proxies, not verified human-action timestamps.
action_scores <- Sim_ActionScores(
  dfResults = sim_data$dfResults,
  dfMetrics = gsm.core::reportingMetrics
)
cross_study_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(sim_data$dfResults, action_scores$dfScores)
```

```{r create-widget, results='asis'}
#### Step 3: Create Cross-Study Widgets ####
cross_study_widget <- Widget_CrossStudyRiskScore(
  dfResults = cross_study_results,
  dfMetrics = gsm.core::reportingMetrics,
  dfGroups = sim_data$dfGroups,
  dfComparisonRiskDetail = action_scores$dfDetail
)

# Display the widget directly in the document
cross_study_widget
```
